scene: Inside the cozy tea hut, departure boards offer travel beyond the hilltop.
picture: A flat side view inside the warm wood-panelled tea hut along one floor level. Far left sits a low tea counter holding a blue reef ticket. The boy in an orange puffer vest stands left of centre. Centre features a wide arched window framing a tethered wicker balloon basket. Far right stands an open door beside a frosty sleigh tram.
shown: a glass-bottomed boat ticket stamped with a lighthouse, lying on the counter far left
a basket hatch open to a striped balloon waiting outside the center arched window
a frosty brass sleigh tram idling at the side platform door on the far right
